drums.description: Hard rock drum track featuring a high-gain, acoustic drum kit, The performance is characterized by a heavy, driving backbeat with a prominent, punchy kick drum and a crisp, cracking snare, The hi-hats are played slightly open for a washier, aggressive texture, frequently transitioning to a ride cymbal with a clear bell ping during intensified sections, Frequent syncopated kick patterns and powerful tom-tom fills punctuate the transitions, The room ambience is tight but natural, suggesting a professional studio environment with moderate compression on the overheads, The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time Publish
